name: DPM++ Ns (Chebyshev-Lobatto collocation)
plain: Single-step p-stage solver: places collocation nodes at Chebyshev-Lobatto points inside the step, evaluates the model at each, and integrates the interpolant.
math: nodes=chebyshev_lobatto_nodes(p,h_η). τ₀=0, x_k=collocation_step(x,τ,x0s,τ_k); σ_k=e^{−(t+τ_k)}; x0_k=model. x=collocation_step(x,τ,x0s,h_η). none, ancestral or sde noise.
